le_feu_represente_l_elan_la_confiance_le: Fire represents drive, confidence, the desire to act, and the ability to engage with enthusiasm.
la_terre_represente_l_ancrage_la_patienc: Earth represents grounding, patience, practicality, and the ability to build something lasting.
l_air_represente_la_pensee_les_echanges_: Air represents thought, communication, curiosity, and your way of understanding the world through ideas.
l_eau_represente_la_sensibilite_l_intuit: Water represents sensitivity, intuition, receptivity, and the depth of your emotional life.
votre_force_reside_dans_votre_capacite_a: Your strength lies in your ability to initiate, to act, and to move forward with courage. Your energy is fueled by movement, enthusiasm, and the desire to create.
prenez_le_temps_de_ralentir_d_ecouter_et: Take the time to slow down, listen, and consolidate your projects. Patience allows your inspiration to produce more lasting results.
une_dominante_de_feu_vous_pousse_a_vivre: A dominant Fire element drives you to live intensely and seek experiences that stimulate your will. Your challenge is to maintain your momentum without acting too quickly or scattering your energy.
votre_force_reside_dans_votre_stabilite_: Your strength lies in your stability, practicality, and your ability to turn an idea into concrete reality.
laissez_davantage_de_place_a_la_spontane: Make more room for spontaneity, intuition, and change. Not everything needs to be perfectly controlled before moving forward.
une_dominante_de_terre_vous_donne_souven: A dominant Earth element often gives you a strong need for security and tangible results. You progress through consistency, but you benefit from accepting that some steps require flexibility.
votre_force_reside_dans_votre_curiosite_: Your strength lies in your curiosity, relational intelligence, and your ability to understand multiple perspectives.
revenez_regulierement_a_vos_emotions_et_: Regularly return to your emotions and sensations. An idea becomes more powerful when it is also felt and embodied.
une_dominante_d_air_favorise_la_reflexio: A dominant Air element encourages reflection, communication, and the need to understand. Your challenge is not to remain solely in analysis when the situation calls for a decision or emotional commitment.
votre_force_reside_dans_votre_intuition_: Your strength lies in your intuition, emotional depth, and your ability to perceive what is not always expressed.
protegez_votre_sensibilite_sans_vous_iso: Protect your sensitivity without isolating yourself. Clear boundaries allow you to remain available to others without absorbing their emotions.
une_dominante_d_eau_intensifie_votre_rec: A dominant Water element intensifies your receptivity and inner life. You may strongly feel atmospheres and unspoken words. Your balance often depends on your ability to distinguish your emotions from those of others.
votre_theme_reunit_plusieurs_formes_d_en: Your natal chart brings together several forms of energy that can complement each other depending on the situations.
observez_les_qualites_que_vous_utilisez_: Observe the qualities you use spontaneously and those that require more attention or practice.
une_repartition_equilibree_peut_indiquer: A balanced distribution may indicate an ability to mobilize different qualities according to circumstances. A complete analysis of the natal chart allows for understanding how these energies cooperate with each other.
les_quatre_elements_revelent_la_maniere_: The four elements reveal how your energy flows naturally. Their balance allows for a better understanding of your spontaneous reactions, your dominant resources, and the qualities that your evolution invites you to develop.
un_element_tres_present_represente_une_e: A highly present element represents an energy you express spontaneously. A less represented element is not a weakness: it often corresponds to a quality you develop through experiences, relationships, and the choices of your journey.
